messages.text: The first implementation passes Python syntax and direct smoke evaluation, but the build check exposed a platform issue: this Windows image has no `/bin/bash`, so the placeholder-style Unix-only build path cannot be the runnable proof. I’m correcting the deliverable to produce only `executable.cmd` on Windows and adjusting the verifier to launch that entrypoint; then the differential failures will represent semantic mismatches rather than a missing artifact.
